items.strategy:
Assume AC as declared, inherited from the equivariant constructible category, the flag-variety theorem and the line-bundle Chern and Euler suppliers. Sources: Varagnolo-Vasserot, Canonical bases and KLR-algebras, SS1.1-1.3 (quivers, graded spaces, the incidence varieties, stable flags and the proper projection; PDF pp. 3-4), SS1.5-1.10 (the canonical module, the convolution formulas, the extrashift dictionary and the source-first composition convention; PDF pp. 6-8), SS2.5-2.9 (relative-position strata, their closures and the convolution inclusions; PDF pp. 9-11); Rouquier, Quiver Hecke algebras and 2-Lie algebras, SS3.2.2 (presentation of the quiver Hecke algebra with $Q_{ii}=0$ and hermitian $Q$; PDF pp. 13-15), SS5.3.5-5.3.6 (flag stacks, orbit decomposition and the vector-bundle description; PDF pp. 41-43) and SS5.4.3 (the Hecke generators as Gysin classes; PDF pp. 44-45).
Step 1 (incidence data and dimension). The graded complete flag variety of the word $
u$ is $F_
u\cong\prod_i\operatorname{Flag}(V_i)$, which is smooth projective of dimension $\sum_i eta_i( eta_i-1)/2$; over a chosen flag the stability condition cuts out the vector subspace of $E$ of dimension $\sum_{a>b}h_{
u_a
u_b}$, so $X_
u	o F_
u$ is a vector bundle of that rank and $\pi_
u$ is projective, hence proper. All of this is the supplied statement of [[lem-smooth-flag-incidence-correspondences-have-the-required-oriented-push-pull-calculus]], with the flag factors from [[lem-flag-variety-of-a-vector-space]].
Step 2 (objects and corners). $L_
u=\pi_{
u!}k[d_
u]$ lies in the equivariant bounded constructible category, and the convolution corner convention $e_\eta\mathfrak Ae_
u=\operatorname{Ext}_G(L_\eta,L_
u)$ with product $a*b=b[n]\circ a$ is the one fixed by [[def-equivariant-borel-moore-homology-and-correspondence-convolution]]; the BM degree of the $(\eta,
u)$ corner is $d_\eta+d_
u-n$ by the Ext/BM shift of that definition.
Step 3 (geometric generator classes). Diagonals give the idempotents; capping the diagonal with $x_r=c_1^G(F^r/F^{r-1})$ gives the dots, with the Hom-line identities $c_1(\operatorname{Hom}(D_a,D_b))=\chi_b-\chi_a$ and $c_1(L^*)=-c_1(L)$ from [[prop-first-chern-class-of-tensor-dual-and-conjugate-lines]]. The relative-position class $[C_{s_r
u,
u}]$ is the standard fundamental class of a closed $G$-stable subvariety of $Z_{s_r
u,
u}$, and the signs defining $\sigma_r$ and $	au_r$ are explicit powers of $-1$ attached to the closed stratum, exactly as in the statement; no BM orientation is changed.
Step 4 (presentation and well-definedness). The listed relations define a quotient of the free algebra, so $S_\Gamma( eta)$ is well posed as a graded algebra; the listed grading makes all defining relations homogeneous because $\deg	au_r=-a_{
u_r
u_{r+1}}$ equals $2h_{ij}+d_
u-d_{s_r
u}$ for distinct colors and $-2$ for equal colors. The claims that the geometric classes realize this graded quotient and the polynomial model are the following two theorems, which discharge the definitions well-definedness; the presentation is internal and no generic KLR item is replaced. [AC as declared]

items.title: Relative-position incidence strata give a faithful geometric PBW basis
items.statement:
Assume the Axiom of Choice as inherited. In the setting of [[def-quiver-full-flag-incidence-varieties-and-geometric-klr-generators]], the convolution algebra $\mathfrak A= igoplus_{\eta,
u}\operatorname{Ext}_G(L_\eta,L_
u)$ acts on the direct sum $P= igoplus_
u P_
u$ of shifted polynomial summands $P_
u=H_G^ ullet(X_
u;k)[d_
u]$, where the unit of $P_
u$ has degree $-d_
u$ and every $x_r$ has degree $2$, and this action is faithful. Fix one reduced expression of every $w\in S_m$ and let $	au_we_
u$ be the corresponding product of elementary crossings of [[def-quiver-full-flag-incidence-varieties-and-geometric-klr-generators]]. Then the elements $x_1^{c_1}\cdots x_m^{c_m}	au_we_
u$ with $c_r\ge0$ form a $k$-basis of $\mathfrak A$; equivalently, the $	au_we_
u$ form a free basis of $\mathfrak A$ over the first-coordinate polynomial corners $k[x_1,\dots,x_m]$. In particular the dots and the elementary crossings generate $\mathfrak A$. Only relative-position incidence strata are paved; nothing is asserted about arbitrary stable-flag fibers of $\pi_
u$.
items.strategy:
Assume AC as declared, inherited from the equivariant, flag-bundle and Euler/Chern suppliers. Sources: Varagnolo-Vasserot, Canonical bases and KLR-algebras, SS1.7-1.9 (the convolution algebra acting on the canonical module and the grading shifts; PDF pp. 7-8), SS2.5-2.9 (relative-position orbits, closures and the convolution inclusions used for the filtration; PDF pp. 9-11), SS2.13-2.21 (torus localization, the Euler classes $\Lambda_w$ and the fixed-point formulas proving faithfulness; PDF pp. 12-15) and SS2.26-2.27 (the free $F_V$-module PBW statement, whose cell proof is left to the reader and is supplied here; PDF pp. 19); Ginzburg, Geometric methods in representation theory, SS1 (the Borel-Moore exact sequence, fundamental classes and the intersection pairing; PDF pp. 4-7) and SS2 (convolution with supports; PDF pp. 7-11); Rouquier, Quiver Hecke algebras and 2-Lie algebras, SS5.4.4 (the corner Ext groups are free graded $H^ ullet(BG)$-modules of computable rank; PDF pp. 43-44).
Step 1 (orbit and stratum decomposition). For fixed $
u$ and $w\in S_m$ the relative-position pair orbit $O_{w,
u}$ is a single $G$-orbit whose stabilizer has a maximal torus and a unipotent remainder; its projection to the first flag is an affine Schubert-cell fibration, and over $O_{w,
u}$ the incidence variety $Z_{w
u,
u}$ is the associated vector bundle with fiber $U_F\cap U_{F'}$. This is the internal Gaussian-elimination and row-echelon argument; the published finite-field relative-position theorem is not used. Its equivariant BM module is a shift of $H_G^ ullet(O)=H_{B\cap wB'w^{-1}}^ ullet(\mathrm{pt})=k[x_1,\dots,x_m]$, because the unipotent part of the stabilizer is contractible.
Step 2 (closure basis). Order relative positions by a linear extension of Bruhat order so that the successive unions of closures are closed. The closed/open Borel-Moore exact sequence from [[thm-constructible-six-functors-proper-base-change-and-verdier-duality]] (support localization) has vanishing odd terms, hence degenerates into short exact sequences in each even degree; the fundamental class of the closure of each stratum restricts to the stratum class and generates the rank-one polynomial quotient. Multiplication by arbitrary first-flag polynomials gives explicit lifts, so the closure fundamental classes form a free left polynomial-module basis, one for each compatible pair $(w,
u)$.
Step 3 (faithfulness). Refine the orbit decomposition by torus-stable Schubert cells: each piece is an affine space with one fixed point and nonzero line-character weights (no arrow weight vanishes, because the quiver is loopless). The closed/open sequences and the vector-bundle Thom and Euler self-intersection calculus of [[lem-complex-oriented-diagonal-thom-class-realizes-the-six-functor-exchange-on-supports]] show that $H_T^{\mathrm{BM}}(Z)$ and $H_T^{\mathrm{BM}}(X)$ are free over the torus polynomial ring $S_T$, and that inverting the finitely many nonzero weights makes fixed-point pushforward an isomorphism, cell by cell; the fixed-pair supported classes multiply as matrix units, so the localized action on $ igoplus_
u H_T^{\mathrm{BM}}(X_
u)$ is faithful. Freeness descends faithfulness to the unlocalized $T$-action, and the restriction $H_G^{\mathrm{BM}}	o H_T^{\mathrm{BM}}$ is injective by the even Schubert-cell filtration of the flag bundle, whose Leray-Hirsch freeness over $H_G^ ullet(\mathrm{pt})$ is [[thm-leray-hirsch-module-isomorphism]] applied at each stage of the projective-bundle tower, with the finite-stage CW structure of [[thm-schubert-cells-give-the-stable-grassmannian-cw-structure]] and the tautological Euler-class fiber generator of [[lem-complex-tautological-euler-class-restricts-to-the-projective-fiber-generator]]. The fiber basis over the arbitrary characteristic-zero field is obtained from the integral basis by extension of coefficients; the published tautological-Euler lemma is stated for $\mathbb Z$ and $\mathbb F_p$, and its free cellular model is the part extended. Hence the $G$-action on $P= igoplus_
u H_G^ ullet(X_
u)[d_
u]$ is faithful.
Step 4 (weighted top coefficient and triangular generation). For a reduced word $w=s_{r_1}\cdots s_{r_l}$, the convolution of the standard elementary classes is supported in positions $\le w$, and its restriction to the open position-$w$ stratum is the standard fundamental class with coefficient $\pm1$; the coefficient is computed with the length-additive weighted inversion-multiset identity $\mathrm{eu}(C_u)\mathrm{eu}(C_v)=\mathrm{eu}(C_{uv})\mathrm{eu}(X_{\mathrm{middle}})$, where each arrow weight occurs with its full multiplicity $h_{ij}$; the normalized signs $\sigma,	au$ change the coefficient only by the explicit unit scalars. Induction on the Bruhat filtration together with the closure-class basis shows that dots and elementary crossings generate $\mathfrak A$, and that the $	au_we_
u$ form a polynomial basis (the change-of-basis matrix from closure classes is triangular with diagonal $\pm1$). [AC as declared]

items.title: Quiver-flag convolution generators satisfy the signed KLR relations
items.statement:
Assume the Axiom of Choice as inherited. In the setting of [[def-quiver-full-flag-incidence-varieties-and-geometric-klr-generators]], the geometric classes $e_
u$, $x_r$ and $	au_r$ satisfy every relation of the intrinsic signed presentation $S_\Gamma( eta)$. They act on the shifted polynomial summands by $e_
u$-projection, multiplication by $x_r$, the equal-color formula $	au_r(f)=(f-s_rf)/(x_r-x_{r+1})$ when $
u_r=
u_{r+1}$, and the distinct-color formula $	au_r(f)=(x_r-x_{r+1})^{h_{ij}}s_r(f)$ for $i=
u_r
e j=
u_{r+1}$ on the $
u$-summand with values in the $s_r
u$-summand, where $s_r$ simultaneously swaps the two variables and the two letters. With the unit of $P_
u$ in degree $-d_
u$ and the variables in degree $2$, the generators $e_
u$, $x_r$, $	au_r$ are homogeneous of degrees $0$, $2$, $-a_{
u_r
u_{r+1}}$. Consequently the generator assignment is a graded $k$-algebra homomorphism $S_\Gamma( eta)	o\mathfrak A$ to the BM convolution algebra.
items.strategy:
Assume AC as declared. Sources: Varagnolo-Vasserot, Canonical bases and KLR-algebras, SS2.16 (the arrow-quotient Euler classes $\mathrm{eu}(d_{V,w,ws})=(\chi_{w(l)}-\chi_{w(l+1)})^{h_{i_{l+1}i_l}}$ and the sign $\mathrm{eu}(n_{V,ws})=-\mathrm{eu}(n_{V,w})$ in the equal case; PDF pp. 13-14), SS2.22-2.25 (the explicit action formulas for the idempotents, dots and elementary classes, and the grading corollary; PDF pp. 15-18) and SS3.3(c) (the presentation and the generator sign dictionary; PDF pp. 20-21); Rouquier, Quiver Hecke algebras and 2-Lie algebras, SS5.4.5-5.4.7 (the geometric verification of the $	au^2$ and $	au^3$ relations, including the multiedge self-intersection computation and all color patterns; PDF pp. 45-46).
Step 1 (units, idempotents, dots). The projections $e_
u$ are orthogonal idempotents summing to $1$; the dots commute, preserve the word, and the slides $	au_rx_t=x_{s_r(t)}	au_r$ follow from $sM_f=M_{sf}s$.
Step 2 (unequal colors). In the stable-arrow quotient the only contribution is $h_{ij}$ copies of $\operatorname{Hom}(D_{r+1},D_r)$, whose standard Euler class is $(x_r-x_{r+1})^{h_{ij}}$: $c_1(\operatorname{Hom}(D_a,D_b))=\chi_b-\chi_a$ ([[prop-first-chern-class-of-tensor-dual-and-conjugate-lines]]) and the Euler class of a complex vector bundle is its top Chern class ([[thm-top-chern-class-equals-euler-class-of-the-underlying-real-bundle]]). After the explicit normalization of $\sigma$ and $	au$ the class $	au_r$ acts by $(x_r-x_{r+1})^{h_{ij}}s_r$, and composing the two oriented crossings gives $	au_r^2e_
u=Q_{
u_r
u_{r+1}}(x_r,x_{r+1})e_
u$ with the stated $Q$; the standard and reverse crossings have the two displayed factors.
Step 3 (equal colors). There is no arrow quotient. The elementary correspondence is the pull-push along the partial flag forgetting $F^r$; its torus-fixed-point calculation has the two tangent Euler classes $x_r-x_{r+1}$ and $x_{r+1}-x_r$, so the standard class acts by $(s_rf-f)/(x_r-x_{r+1})$ and the chosen $\sigma_r=	au_r=-[C]_{\mathrm{standard}}$ acts by the divided difference $(f-s_rf)/(x_r-x_{r+1})$, which is polynomial because the numerator is divisible. Hence $	au_r^2e_
u=0=Q_{ii}e_
u$, $	au_rx_r-x_{r+1}	au_r=1$ and $	au_rx_{r+1}-x_r	au_r=-1$.
Step 4 (disjoint and braid relations). Disjoint crossings use disjoint variables and commute. The braid difference is checked on the finitely many color patterns of three consecutive letters: all distinct, $i,i,j$, $j,i,i$, all equal, and $i,j,i$ with $i
e j$. Expanding the divided differences in the skew group algebra gives the nil-Hecke braid in the all-equal case, zero in the first three patterns, and, for outer equal colors, the polynomial correction $ igl[Q_{
u_r
u_{r+1}}(x_r,x_{r+1})-Q_{
u_r
u_{r+1}}(x_{r+2},x_{r+1}) igr]/(x_{r+2}-x_r)$ with the full multiplicities $h_{ij},h_{ji}$; this is a finite identity valid for arbitrary edge multiplicities and both arrow directions.
Step 5 (degrees and transfer). The degree bookkeeping $2h_{ij}+d_
u-d_{s_r
u}=h_{ij}+h_{ji}=-a_{ij}$ (distinct) and $-2=-a_{ii}$ (equal) shows that the generators are homogeneous of the stated degrees, so the relations are homogeneous and the assignment is a graded homomorphism. Because the action of [[thm-quiver-flag-relative-position-strata-give-a-faithful-geometric-pbw-basis]] is faithful, the operator identities proved in Steps 2-4 are identities in the convolution algebra. [AC as declared]

items.title: Signed KLR algebra is the equivariant Ext algebra of quiver-flag complexes
items.statement:
Assume the Axiom of Choice as inherited. Let $\Gamma$, $ eta$ and $k$ be as in [[def-quiver-full-flag-incidence-varieties-and-geometric-klr-generators]]. There is a unique graded $k$-algebra isomorphism $$S_\Gamma( eta)\xrightarrow{\ \sim\ }\operatorname{Ext}_G^ ullet\Bigl( igoplus_
u\pi_{
u!}k[d_
u], igoplus_
u\pi_{
u!}k[d_
u]\Bigr)$$ sending $e_
u$, $x_r$, $	au_r$ to the diagonal, Chern and normalized elementary classes of [[def-quiver-full-flag-incidence-varieties-and-geometric-klr-generators]], where the Ext algebra carries the shifted multiplication $a*b=b[n]\circ a$ for homogeneous $a$ of degree $n$. On the $(\eta,
u)$ component, Ext degree $n$ corresponds to BM degree $d_\eta+d_
u-n$. No semisimplicity, purity, decomposition or finiteness hypothesis on $E$ or on the $Z_{\eta,
u}$ is required.
items.strategy:
Assume AC as declared. Sources: Varagnolo-Vasserot, Canonical bases and KLR-algebras, SS3.1-3.2 (the KLR algebra with its faithful polynomial module and grading; PDF pp. 19-20), SS3.3(c) (the defining presentation; PDF pp. 20-21), SS3.4-3.6 and SS3.9 (PBW and the unique graded isomorphism $R_V\cong\delta Z_V$ intertwining the actions; PDF pp. 21-24); Ginzburg, Geometric methods in representation theory, SS5 Proposition 5.1 with the local product-compatibility reconstruction of [[thm-verdier-duality-identification-intertwines-yoneda-product-and-convolution]] (PDF pp. 19-20); Rouquier, Quiver Hecke algebras and 2-Lie algebras, SS3.2.2-3.2.3 (PBW and the faithful polynomial realization; PDF pp. 13-17).
Step 1 (the map). The relation theorem [[thm-quiver-flag-convolution-generators-satisfy-the-signed-klr-relations]] says that the assignment $e_
u\mapsto e_
u$, $x_r\mapsto x_r$, $	au_r\mapsto	au_r$ respects every defining relation of $S_\Gamma( eta)$; hence it induces a graded algebra homomorphism $\Phi:S_\Gamma( eta)	o\mathfrak A$ into the shifted Ext algebra, and $\Phi$ is unique with this generator condition.
Step 2 (surjectivity). The geometric PBW theorem [[thm-quiver-flag-relative-position-strata-give-a-faithful-geometric-pbw-basis]] exhibits the classes $x_1^{c_1}\cdots x_m^{c_m}	au_we_
u$ as a $k$-basis of $\mathfrak A$; all of them are images of elements of $S_\Gamma( eta)$, so $\Phi$ is surjective.
Step 3 (injectivity). The intrinsic quotient is spanned by the same normal forms: move dots left across crossings by the mixed and slide relations, each correction removing a crossing; reduce a nonreduced adjacent word by far and braid moves to one containing a repeated adjacent reflection, and remove the pair of crossings by the square relation; braid corrections have strictly fewer crossings. Equivalently, adjacent sorting of the letters gives the same conclusion: move the largest letter to its final position and induct, where two sorting moves either act on disjoint positions and commute or differ on three positions by the braid relation. Hence $S_\Gamma( eta)$ is spanned by $\{x_1^{c_1}\cdots x_m^{c_m}	au_we_
u\}$ for one fixed reduced expression of each $w$, and their images under $\Phi$ are linearly independent by Step 2; so $\Phi$ is injective. This argument is intrinsic and does not use the existing generic KLR presentation.
Step 4 (product compatibility and conclusion). The identification of the shifted product $a*b=b[n]\circ a$ with the geometric convolution product is exactly the statement of [[thm-verdier-duality-identification-intertwines-yoneda-product-and-convolution]], applied cornerwise to the identification $\operatorname{Ext}_G^n(L_\eta,L_
u)\cong H^{\mathrm{BM},G}_{d_\eta+d_
u-n}(Z_{\eta,
u})$ of [[thm-proper-pushforward-ext-is-equivariant-borel-moore-homology-of-the-fiber-product]]; no semismallness, decomposition theorem or smoothness of the fiber products is used. items.title: Equal-color quiver-flag correspondence is nilHecke
items.statement:
Assume the Axiom of Choice as inherited. Take the one-vertex loopless quiver with no arrows, $ eta=2\alpha_i$ and the unique word $
u=(i,i)$. Then $E=\{0\}$, $F_
u=X_
u=\operatorname{Flag}(\mathbb C^2)=\mathbb P^1$, $d_
u=1$, $Z_{
u,
u}=\mathbb P^1	imes\mathbb P^1$, and the elementary correspondence $	au_1$ acts on the shifted polynomial summand $P_
u=k[x_1,x_2]$ (unit in degree $-1$) by the divided difference $$	au_1(f)= rac{f-s_1f}{x_1-x_2}.$$ In particular $	au_1$ is homogeneous of degree $-2=-a_{ii}$, and $	au_1^2=0$, $	au_1x_1-x_2	au_1=1$, $	au_1x_2-x_1	au_1=-1$; the one-corner convolution algebra is the rank-two nil-Hecke algebra.

Step 1: for this data $E=\{0\}$ and $X_
u=\operatorname{Flag}(\mathbb C^2)=\mathbb P^1$ with $d_
u=1$; hence $Z_{
u,

Step 2: the relative-position-$s_1$ stratum is the complement of the diagonal and its closure is all of $\mathbb P^1	imes\mathbb P^1$; at the two torus-fixed points of a $\mathbb P^1$ fiber the tangent Euler classes are $x_1-x_2$ and $x_2-x_1$, so the standard fundamental class acts by $(s_1f-f)/(x_1-x_2)$ and the normalized class $	au_1=-[C]_{\mathrm{standard}}$ acts by the displayed divided difference. Step 3: the identities $	au_1^2=0$, $	au_1x_1-x_2	au_1=1$, $	au_1x_2-x_1	au_1=-1$ follow by direct evaluation on polynomials, and the degree is $-2=-a_{ii}$; equivalently, the operators $x_1,x_2,	au_1$ satisfy the nil-Hecke presentation of rank two, matching [[thm-quiver-flag-convolution-generators-satisfy-the-signed-klr-relations]] in the all-equal color case.
